# graphiant_site (Data Source)

Looks up a single Graphiant site by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_site" "hq" {
  id = 12345
}

output "hq_edge_count" {
  value = data.graphiant_site.hq.edge_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Site identifier.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Resolved postal address for the site location.
- `created_at` (String)
- `edge_count` (Number)
- `location` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `name` (String) Site name.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes about the site.
- `policy_reference_count` (Number)
- `segment_count` (Number)
- `site_list_reference_count` (Number)
- `tags` (List of String) Tags applied to the site.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `location`

Read-Only:

- `address_line1` (String)
- `address_line2` (String)
- `city` (String)
- `country` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `latitude` (Number)
- `longitude` (Number)
- `notes` (String)
- `province_code` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `state_code` (String)
